policies.title: Grenada: Republic of the Congo ordinary passports
policies.summary: Grenada's live Embassy schedule places Congo in the prior-arrival category, which it defines as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Republic of the Congo passport for short visitor travel.
The schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document travel are not classified by this policy.

policies.title: Panama: Republic of the Congo ordinary passports
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule names Republic of the Congo in the stamped-visa cohort, requiring prior consular processing before travel for visitors without the separate third-country-document waiver.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Republic of the Congo passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.

The stamped-visa instructions require the same prior paperwork as the authorized-visa route and personal appearance at the consulate for passport stamping if granted; approval may take up to 30 business days.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, invitation and final-admission treatment are not classified by this policy.

application.label: Panama Embassy stamped-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 30 business days, depending on verification and document completion.
steps: Determine that the separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Submit the listed stamped-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate.
If granted, appear personally at the consulate to have the visa stamped in the passport before travel.

policies.title: The Bahamas: Republic of the Congo ordinary passports
policies.summary: The Bahamas' current visitor schedule directly requires a Republic of the Congo passport to hold a visitor visa, while the current Foreign Ministry service issues the entry visa electronically before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Republic of the Congo passport for short visitor travel.
The official schedule's passport row marks the visitor visa requirement Yes and lists three months; the separate Zaire row distinguishes the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Apply for the electronic entry visa through the Bahamas Ministry of Foreign Affairs before travel.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are not classified by this policy.

application.label: Bahamas electronic entry visa application
steps: Open the Ministry of Foreign Affairs electronic entry visa service and create an application.
Submit the required passport, visitor and supporting details and pay the applicable fee.
Receive the decision before travel and carry the required entry documents.
